summary: Figure 2 sketches Aqua's design as three named components arranged around a multi-GPU NVLink Domain. Several servers (drawn as stacked sheets) each hold 8 GPUs in a grid; GPU 8 is highlighted in dark magenta. A brace under the domain leads down to AQUA-PROF, which connects rightward to AQUA-PLACER, which in turn arrows back up into the domain at GPU 8, suggesting a profile-then-place control loop. AQUA-LIB sits to the right, wired with a bidirectional arrow to GPU 4 and an incoming arrow from GPU 8. Two dashed arrows inside the domain (GPU 2 to GPU 6, GPU 4 to GPU 8) hint at intra-domain data movement, though the retrieved paper text is truncated just before it explains what each named component does, so those roles are inferred mainly from the figure and component names rather than confirmed prose.
